caption:
New build in Brampton? Your 5 steps from signing to keys.

1) Have a real estate lawyer review the agreement before you sign. 2) Pay your deposits on the dates in your agreement. 3) Pick finishes and upgrades by the builder's deadlines. 4) Walk the home with the builder at the pre-delivery inspection. 5) Confirm your mortgage approval is still valid before closing.

Send this to someone buying a new build. General information only, not legal, tax or mortgage advice.

Buying in Brampton? Comment INFO to get full details, or call 905-452-4298.

Krishna Rander, Realtor® | PROPERTY.CA INC., Brokerage

4 first-home mistakes to avoid in Waterloo Region.

1) Shopping before you have a mortgage pre-approval. 2) Skipping the home inspection to win the offer. 3) Forgetting land transfer tax and legal fees. 4) Stretching to your maximum pre-approval amount.

A buyer asked me how to price an offer. 4 steps.

1) Start with recent sales of similar homes nearby, not just the list price. 2) Ask your Realtor® to compare size, age, condition and location. 3) Know your own ceiling before you write the offer. 4) Decide your conditions too: financing and inspection protect you.
